topic: Dolphin: can sleep with half of its brain at a time, so one half stays alert and it can keep coming up to breathe.

episode.title: Dolphin’s Amazing Half-Asleep Superpower!

shots.narration: Did you know dolphins can sleep and stay alert?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D animated tropical ocean, a cute realistic dolphin just beneath turquoise water, no text.
shots.action: The dolphin slowly closes one eye.
shots.mood: Sunny water sparkles around the dolphin's peaceful face.

shots.narration: Kiko spots a dolphin resting beneath the waves.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny rocky shoreline beside clear deep water, Kiko in his green safari hat and khaki vest, dolphin visible underwater.
shots.action: Kiko leans forward to watch the dolphin.
shots.mood: Bright coastal colours and curious anticipation.

shots.narration: [surprised] But dolphins breathe air. How can this one keep sleeping?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Kiko safely seated back from the shoreline edge, resting dolphin visible through clear ocean water.
shots.action: Kiko raises his hands with his palms upward.
shots.mood: Kiko's lifted eyebrows show a gentle, puzzled concern.

shots.narration: Their secret: only half the brain sleeps at a time.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close underwater view of a realistic dolphin's head against softly glowing blue water.
shots.action: The dolphin glides slowly past the camera.
shots.mood: Peaceful blue light and a sense of discovery.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of the dolphin's open eye, sunlight rippling over its smooth grey skin.
shots.action: The dolphin turns its head toward the sunlit surface.
shots.mood: Clear, attentive eye beneath warm shafts of sunlight.

shots.narration: [excited] That helps the dolphin keep coming up to breathe!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, underwater view looking toward the bright ocean surface, dolphin below the rippling water.
shots.action: The dolphin rises toward the surface.

shots.narration: Up it comes for air through its blowhole.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, water-level view of the dolphin's head and back at the surface of a calm turquoise sea.
shots.action: The dolphin exhales a brief mist through its blowhole.
shots.mood: Sparkling droplets and a bright, reassuring atmosphere.

shots.narration: Mystery solved: resting, breathing, and staying alert!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny shoreline with Kiko safely seated on a broad rock, dolphin resting at the surface beyond him.
shots.mood: Warm sunshine, Kiko's broad smile, and calm blue water.

shots.narration: [whispers] Next mystery: which animal can taste with its feet? Guess!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Kiko beside coastal flowers with the ocean behind him, no other animals visible.
shots.action: Kiko points toward the colourful flowers.
shots.mood: Playful curiosity in a bright, inviting coastal garden.

episode.endHook: Which animal can taste with its feet? Guess our next explorer!
episode.description: How can a dolphin sleep and still come up for air? Join Kiko to discover how resting half its brain helps this ocean explorer stay alert.
